fields.description: Program Description Teaching Objective The colleague is aimed to train to adapt to the development of computer science, obsess scientific literacy and cultural accomplishment, the basic theoretical knowledge of computer science and practical theory. Course Structure We can see core courses of Computer Science and Technology among the four years: Course Name Credits Advanced Mathematics I 5.0 Programming Language C 4.5 Advanced Mathematics II 5.0 Discrete Mathematics 4.5 Algorithm and Data Structure 4.5 Comprehensive Chinese IV 4.5 Computer Organization 4.5 Computer Networks 4.0 Operating System 4.0 Microcontroller’s Principle and Applications 4.0 Career and Internship Graduates can be the senior computer technical engineers engage in the development, maintenance, technical service and technical management in the field of computer.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Passport empty visa page * 3. Certification of no criminal record * 4. High school graduate certificate According to Liaoning Province Government requirement: graduate certificate in language other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be notarized. If you can not find translation organization, please contact counselor@cucas.cn. Graduation certificate must be notarized and translated into Chinese by the notary office in your country or China(For those who studied in China for previous education). * 5. High school academic transcript According to Liaoning Province Government requirement: academic transcript in language other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be notarized. If you can not find translation organization, please contact counselor@cucas.cn. Academic transcript must be notarized and translated into Chinese by the notary office in your country or China(For those who studied in China for previous education). * 6. Physical examination record for foreigner Physical examination record for foreigner * 7. 2 minutes Self-introduction video in English * 8. Passport first page * 9. English proficiency certificate TOFEL or IELTS certificate for the native language is Non-English students. * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Under the age of 25, senior high school graduation or with equivalent qualification of 12-year education background. Mathematics, physics and chemistry with 60 of total marks results are necessary for engineering degree courses. 2. English competence certificates: -Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from proof of English language proficiency. -The applicants that use English as the language of instruction at high school, may use the language certificate issued by the high school. -If the applicant does not meet any of above criteria, then IELTS or TOFELresult is preferred. -If the applicant cannot provide any English competence certificate mentioned above, SAU will evaluate the applicant's English level by checking the English self-introduction video and English result on the transcript. 3.
